mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, sex, avatar, role, department_id, status, login_ip, login_date, pwd_update_date, del_flag, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time FROM user WHERE username = #{username} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT id, username, nickname, email, phone, sex, avatar, role, department_id, status, login_ip, login_date, create_time, update_time FROM user WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, nickname, email, phone, sex, role, department_id, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{role}, #{departmentId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET password = #{password}, pwd_update_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET nickname = #{nickname}, sex = #{sex}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET del_flag = '2' WHERE id = #{id}
